title: Australian man records astronaut private channel

tellings.quote: Um who the hell did we meet? some guy from Australia that um had been recording and when they switched to a different channel, he was able to switch

plain: A man named Charlie Foltz, who tells of alien abduction experiences, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a man from Australia he once met. According to Foltz, this man had been recording radio traffic from early American astronauts, and when the astronauts switched to a different, private channel, he was able to switch too. The suggestion is that he caught things the astronauts said that were not meant for the public.
